narrative_vs_numbers.summary: Pidilite management exhibited exceptional operational consistency across FY26 and Q1 FY27, consistently meeting or exceeding its stated operating EBITDA margin corridor of 20% to 24%. The company effectively managed raw material procurement, keeping VAM consumption at about $830 in Q3 FY26 against an anticipated sub-$900 level, and expanded margins to 26.4% in Q1 FY27 despite raw material inflation via proactive pricing.

guided.guidance: Management guided to an EBITDA corridor of 20% to 24%.
guided.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (15-May-2026), PDF p. 12 — "at this moment, I would say we have guided a corridor of 20% to 24%. We stay committed to that guidance."

delivered.actual: Standalone EBITDA margins reached 26.4%, improving by 80 basis points quarter-on-quarter.
delivered.source: Q1 FY27 Concall Transcript (12-Aug-2026), PDF p. 4 — "EBITDA margins at 26.4% improved by 80 basis points quarter-on-quarter and profit after tax grew by 27.7%."

quarters.commentary: Pidilite surpassed the top end of its operating corridor as proactive replacement-cost pricing lifted standalone EBITDA margin to 26.4%.

guided.guidance: Management guided to maintain an EBITDA corridor of 20% to 24%.
guided.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (11-Feb-2026), PDF p. 10 — "because for us, the EBITDA corridor which we have shared is 20% to 24%."

delivered.actual: Delivered standalone EBITDA margin of 23.4%, expanding by 280 bps versus same period last year.
delivered.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (15-May-2026), PDF p. 3 — "And EBITDA margin at 23.4% expanded by 280 bps versus same period last year."

quarters.commentary: Pidilite delivered standalone EBITDA margin of 23.4%, sitting comfortably inside the targeted 20% to 24% corridor.

guided.guidance: Management guided that VAM is below $900 and expected to remain in that range for the next 3 to 6 months.
guided.source: Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (06-Nov-2025), PDF p. 4 — "VAM is now below $900. Basically, what we are seeing for the next 3 to 6 months"

guided.guidance: Management stated comfort operating within an EBITDA corridor of 20% to 24%.
guided.source: Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (06-Nov-2025), PDF p. 8 — "We have always called out that we are very comfortable to operate within an EBITDA corridor of 20% to 24%."

delivered.actual: VAM consumption in the quarter stood at about $830 compared to $884 in the same period last year.
delivered.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (11-Feb-2026), PDF p. 4 — "VAM consumption in the quarter was at about $830 as compared to $884 in the same period last year."

delivered.actual: Stand-alone EBITDA margins improved by about 24 basis points and stood at 24.5%.
delivered.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (11-Feb-2026), PDF p. 4 — "our stand-alone EBITDA margins improved by about 24 basis points and stand at 24.5%."

quarters.commentary: Input costs tracked management expectations with VAM at $830 against sub-$900 expectations, and standalone EBITDA margin reached 24.5%.

guided.guidance: Management maintained that blended EBITDA margins comfortable for the business are in the 20% to 24% zone.
guided.source: Q1 FY26 Concall Transcript (14-Aug-2025), PDF p. 14 — "blended EBITDA margins that we are comfortable with is in the 20% to 24% zone."

delivered.actual: In the first half, margins reached the higher end of that corridor at about 24%.
delivered.source: Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (06-Nov-2025), PDF p. 5 — "As you saw in first half, we are at the higher end of that corridor, we are actually at about 24%."

quarters.commentary: Operating margins tracked at the top end of the guided corridor, delivering about 24% for the first half of the fiscal year.

narrative_vs_numbers.pattern: Management reliably guides to an EBITDA margin band of 20% to 24% while deliberately operating at the upper boundary or exceeding it through disciplined pricing, proactive cost management, and reinvestment into advertising.
